Safe 0x7c4c7ac39f3db79b10400b17a2f67dd6a4e9fec3 on Ethereum Mainnet (chain ID 1), Safe transaction 0xbc18c4ebfeacb4f779742101e745d912215294e3398a56217e14f16c11c00d85 (nonce 7), under Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre. Disputed rule: R-4.5. The transaction delegate calls MultiSendCallOnly 1.3.0 with 31 approve calls, each for 2^256 - 1, to three spenders. Three of them approve WETH (0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2), which emitted an ERC-20 Approval event with an amount when the Safe approved it in transaction 0x3fe02c5882cbdd5ed6c849adf0b393d7b23ac913b95703709da635602a009bc1 (block 26280201). A max uint256 ERC-20 approval is always functionally unlimited, and the Council rules immediately (R-4.5, § 2.5). Distinguishing 0x404a6460…, which weighed a non-max amount, the transaction is insecure under R-4.5.
